entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-22
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • SQLite SQL generation fails when dropping both tables in a foreign-key cycle #39761
  • SQLite migration fails with foreign key mismatch when adding a composite principal key #39760
  • GroupBy with Select(...).Distinct().Count() on a nullable column doesn't count NULL #39759
  • SQLite: TimeSpan and float in JSON are stored differently from columns/parameters, so equality and Contains miss rows #39758
  • SaveChangesFailed interceptor is skipped when automatic change detection throws #39757

PullRequests

Created

  • Bind complex properties over single-result subqueries #39763
    community-contribution
  • Raise SaveChangesFailed when DetectChanges throws during SaveChanges #39762
    community-contribution

Updated

  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39750
  • Fix SQLite IndexOf StringComparison overload matching #39755
    community-contribution
